item.subject: science
item.stem:
Riya draws this feeding diagram for a school garden in her science notebook. In it, grass is eaten by both a grasshopper and a rabbit; the grasshopper is eaten by a frog and a sparrow; the frog is eaten by a snake; the rabbit is eaten by a fox; and the sparrow and the snake are both eaten by an eagle.

What should Riya call this diagram?

options.A: A food chain, because it starts with grass, which is a producer
options.B: A food web, because the organisms are connected through many interlinked feeding paths
options.C: A food chain, because the arrows show the flow of energy in one direction
options.D: A food web, because it contains more than three organisms
